{{Quote|In the name of Governor-General Sebastian Parnell, greetings. This exhibit has been prepared to educate citizens regarding the consequences of criminal activity in this sector of the Empire. I am Lieutenant Salva, your guide for this tour. Follow me.|Lieutenant Salva, to a group of tourists on Tol Ado|<ref name="Jedi's Honor">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Salva]] was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In about [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Salva led a number of tourists in a tour of an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]].
